title: Function Decorators and the R Ecosystem
text: fmisc ships small toolkit composable function operators (“decorators”): with_retry(), with_timing(), with_logging(), with_cache(), with_rate_limit(). cover common cross-cutting concerns without pulling heavy dependencies, compose freely native pipe, can inspected (print()), unwrapped (undecorate()), tested isolation. intentionally stay minimal. vignette summarises keep using reach dedicated package instead.

title: Function Decorators and the R Ecosystem
text: Use with_retry() need exponential backoff jitter, selective retry via .on_error, retry callback — dependencies beyond cli. Reach purrr::insistently() (purrr::quietly() / purrr::safely()) already inside purrr pipeline want retry semantics integrate adverb style. Note insistently() retries error unless combined rate_backoff(), offer exponential backoff jitter .

title: Function Decorators and the R Ecosystem
text: contest — with_cache() facade memoise::memoise() backed cachem::cache_mem(): .max_size maps cachem’s max_n (LRU eviction), .ttl max_age. need -memory LRU/TTL cache — disk persistence (cache_disk), shared caches, cache pruning — use memoise directly; every cachem backend one argument away:
code: fast <- with_cache(slow, .max_size = 1024, .ttl = 3600) memo <- memoise::memoise(slow, cache = cachem::cache_disk("~/.cache"))

title: Function Decorators and the R Ecosystem

title: Function Decorators and the R Ecosystem

title: Miscellaneous R Utilities
text: Various utilities software development R: composable function decorators, memory-aware chunked processing, smart parallel apply, rich error messages, package-development helpers.

title: Miscellaneous R Utilities
text: Function decorators: stackable function operators — retry exponential backoff (with_retry()), timing (with_timing()), logging (with_logging()), memoisation (with_cache()), rate limiting (with_rate_limit()). Compose decorate(), inspect is_decorated(), unwrap undecorate(). Chunking & RAM management: process data larger memory via process_with_chunks(), automatic chunk sizing, cross-platform RAM monitoring (Rcpp-accelerated), disk spillover. Smart parallel computing: smart_parallel_apply() picks OS-appropriate backend automatically falls back sequential processing backend available. Better errors: stop2() produces rich, {interpolated} error messages via cli/rlang base-R fallback. Development tools: best-practices function template (use_function_template()) package Makefile (use_make2()).

title: Memoise a function's results — with_cache
text: Wraps f repeated calls arguments return cached value. thin facade memoise::memoise() backed cachem::cache_mem(): memoise hashes arguments internally, cache_mem provides LRU eviction (.max_size) time--live (.ttl).

title: Memoise a function's results — with_cache
Memoise a function's results — with_cache
text: f function wrap. ... Reserved future extension. .max_size Maximum number cached entries. Inf (default) unbounded; exceeded, least-recently-used entries evicted. .ttl Time--live seconds cached entries. Inf (default) never expires.

title: Memoise a function's results — with_cache
text: function forwards arguments f. Attach cache_clear() cache_info() helpers via cache_clear() cache_info().

what: Log calls, results, and errors of a function — with_logging
title: Log calls, results, and errors of a function — with_logging
text: Wraps f lightweight logger emitting "call", "success", "error" events. default logger uses cli alerts. Errors logged re-raised unchanged.

title: Log calls, results, and errors of a function — with_logging
code: with_logging(   f,   ...,   .logger = NULL,   .log_args = TRUE,   .log_result = FALSE,   .name = NULL )

title: Log calls, results, and errors of a function — with_logging
text: f function wrap. ... Reserved future extension. .logger Optional user function function(event, data); event one "call", "success", "error"; data list least name, plus event-specific fields. Default NULL uses cli. .log_args Logical. Whether include short deparse arguments "call" event. Default TRUE. .log_result Logical. Whether include short deparse return value "success" event. Default FALSE. .name Optional character name display function. Defaults deparsed f symbol.

title: Rate-limit a function to N calls per period — with_rate_limit

what: Retry a function with exponential backoff — with_retry
title: Retry a function with exponential backoff — with_retry
text: Wraps f error call retried max_tries times, delay backoff^attempt seconds attempts (optionally jittered capped).

title: Retry a function with exponential backoff — with_retry
code: with_retry(   f,   max_tries = 3L,   backoff = 2,   ...,   .on_error = NULL,   .max_delay = Inf,   .jitter = TRUE,   .on_retry = NULL,   .message = FALSE )

title: Retry a function with exponential backoff — with_retry
text: f function wrap. max_tries Positive integer. Maximum number attempts (including first). Default 3. backoff Non-negative number. Base exponential delay seconds; delay attempt k backoff^k. Default 2 (.e. 2, 4, 8, 16 s). Use 0 disable delays. ... Passed wrapped function call. Reserved future extensions; currently forwarded via wrapper's .... .on_error Optional predicate function(cnd) -> logical, character vector condition classes retry (e.g. c("http_error_503")), mirroring httr2's is_transient idiom. predicate returns FALSE (error matches none classes) error re-raised immediately. Default NULL retries errors. .max_delay Numeric cap individual retry delays seconds. Default Inf. .jitter Logical. TRUE (default), delay multiplied uniform random factor [0.5, 1.5] avoid synchronized retries. .on_retry Optional callback function(attempt, delay, cnd) invoked sleep. Errors callback swallowed. .message Logical. TRUE, emits message() retry describing attempt delay. Default FALSE.

title: Retry a function with exponential backoff — with_retry
text: function forwards arguments f. persistent failure raises condition class "fmisc_retry_exhausted" preserving original condition's classes.

title: Retry a function with exponential backoff — with_retry
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ flaky <- function(x) {   if (runif(1) < 0.7) stop("transient")   x * 2 } robust <- with_retry(flaky, max_tries = 5, backoff = 0.1) robust(21) } # }

what: Measure a function's elapsed wall-clock time — with_timing
title: Measure a function's elapsed wall-clock time — with_timing
text: Wraps f call timed proc.time(). Reports elapsed time success failure (via .exit()), either cli message, attached "elapsed" attribute return value, passed user callback.

title: Measure a function's elapsed wall-clock time — with_timing

Reserved future extension. .report One "message" (default; cli info alert), "attribute" (attach attr(result, "elapsed")), "callback" (invoke .callback(name, elapsed, ok)). .callback Function used .report = "callback". .threshold Non-negative numeric. report elapsed time seconds >= .threshold. Default 0.

text: get_flir_rules() removed, calling errors listing fmisc -package field flir/config.yml longer loads rules. bundled rules , deprecated-sample-n deprecated-sample-frac (rewrote dplyr’s superseded sample_n() sample_frac()), gone replacement: write rules project instead, drop -package entry. flir longer Suggests, using-fmisc vignette documented integration removed, vignette("using-fmisc") errors (#62).

title: fmisc 0.2.0
text: with_cache() now thin facade memoise::memoise() backed cachem::cache_mem(). .max_size maps max_n (LRU eviction) .ttl max_age; hand-rolled environment backend deparse()-based key scheme gone (memoise hashes internally). .key argument removed: custom cache keys supported memoise, drop-replacement. cache_info() now reports backend = "cachem" size, max_n, max_age (old "env"/"memoise" backends keys element gone). memoise cachem moved Suggests Imports.

title: fmisc 0.2.0
text: with_retry() gains two conveniences: .on_error now also accepts character vector condition classes retry (e.g. c("http_error_503")), mirroring httr2’s is_transient idiom; .message = TRUE toggle emits message() retry. undecorate() gains depth argument (default 1); depth = Inf unwraps full decorator chain. New vignette vignette("decorators") compares decorators purrr::insistently(), memoise + cachem, ratelimitr, documents deliberate skip burst-tolerant rate limiting (use httr2::req_throttle() HTTP burst needs). Decorated functions now record applied decorator (name + key parameters) "fmisc_stack" attribute, accumulated wrappers compose via decorate() native pipe. print() "fmisc_decorated" object shows wrapper stack outermost-first.

title: fmisc 0.2.0
text: with_retry() — retry exponential backoff, jitter, .on_error predicate, .on_retry callback, .max_delay cap. Raises "fmisc_retry_exhausted" final failure preserving original condition’s classes. with_timing() — wall-clock timing via proc.time(), reported cli message, "elapsed" attribute, callback; reports success failure. with_logging() — call/success/error events via default cli logger custom .logger(event, data). with_cache() — memoisation facade memoise::memoise() + cachem::cache_mem() LRU eviction (.max_size) time--live (.ttl). Companions: cache_clear(), cache_info(). with_rate_limit() — throttle n calls per rolling period seconds; either wait raise "fmisc_rate_limit_exceeded". Composition helpers: decorate() composes unary decorators left--right; is_decorated() undecorate() inspect wrapper chain.
